import sys, time, json, random, subprocess; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from harness import *
build()
def consistent(off,n): return bytes(((off+i)*7+3)&0xff for i in range(n))
# max header attempts: many tiny envelopes per datagram (<=256 per datagram, <=32768 total)
traces=[]
for t in range(64):
    events=[{'keys':['I','H','A']}]
    for e in range(127):
        w=b''.join(envelope('I', i, b'\x01', width=1) for i in range(4))   # 4 headers per datagram
        events.append(datagram(w, auth=(0,)*4))
    traces.append(trace(events))
data=json.dumps({'traces':traces}).encode()
t0=time.time(); p=subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=data,capture_output=True); t1=time.time()
out=json.loads(p.stdout)
print('headers total', sum(len(x['packets']) for x in out['traces']), 'wall %.2f'%(t1-t0), 'out', len(p.stdout))
# 8192 distinct streams, each with 4096 nonempty STREAM frames -> too big; use 8192 streams x 8 frames
traces=[]
for t in range(8):
    events=[{'keys':['A']}]
    for e in range(1000):
        bodies=b''.join(stream(4*i, 0, b'xy') for i in range(8))
        events.append(datagram(envelope('A', e, bodies), auth=(0,)))
    traces.append(trace(events, bidi=2**60))
data=json.dumps({'traces':traces}).encode()
t0=time.time(); p=subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=data,capture_output=True); t1=time.time()
out=json.loads(p.stdout)
print('streams', sum(len(x['streams']) for x in out['traces']), 'packets', sum(len(x['packets']) for x in out['traces']),
      'statuses', set(s for x in out['traces'] for s in [p['status'] for p in x['packets']]), 'wall %.2f'%(t1-t0), 'out', len(p.stdout))
# one stream with many frames (overlap churn)
traces=[]
events=[{'keys':['A']}]
for e in range(4000):
    events.append(datagram(envelope('A', e, stream(0, (e%500)*4, consistent((e%500)*4,4))), auth=(0,)))
traces.append(trace(events))
data=json.dumps({'traces':traces}).encode()
t0=time.time(); p=subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=data,capture_output=True); t1=time.time()
out=json.loads(p.stdout)
r=out['traces'][0]
print('churn', r['packets'][-1]['status'], r['streams'][0]['ranges'], r['streams'][0]['unique'], 'wall %.2f'%(t1-t0))
# huge single ack (bounded by wire)
traces=[]
events=[{'keys':['A']}]
pairs=[(0,0)]*200000
body=bytes([2])+v(2**62-1)+v(0)+v(len(pairs))+v(0)+b''.join(v(0)+v(0) for _ in pairs)
events.append(datagram(envelope('A',0,body), auth=(0,)))
traces.append(trace(events))
data=json.dumps({'traces':traces}).encode()
print('big ack input', len(data))
t0=time.time(); p=subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=data,capture_output=True); t1=time.time()
out=json.loads(p.stdout); r=out['traces'][0]
print('bigack', r['packets'][0]['status'], r['acknowledged'][2]['count'], r['acknowledged'][2]['intervals'], 'wall %.2f'%(t1-t0))
EOF
